reading: All three successful calls returned mode=student, which is CORRECT rather than a miss: the upstream gate permits a takeover only on execution_status=failed or intent_status=misaligned, and this is a successful demonstration with neither. Every call reported execution_status=uncertain for the same stated reason - one frame per call, so gate question 1 (what happened during the last executed chunk) has no before/after evidence to work on.
what_it_demonstrates: Astra derived the dishwasher subgoals from the instruction alone
task_progress advanced across ticks: at t=200 it moved 'Approached the handle' into verified_completed
it used our FK preview quantitatively ('flange rises 0.978 -> 1.128 m', 'shifts roughly 2 cm laterally')
it respected the unverified tool transform unprompted and refused to claim contact
what_it_does_not_demonstrate: that Astra corrects anything - no edit was produced or possible here
anything about pi0.5, whose proposals were not involved in this run
next: Give it prior observations so execution_status can be something other than uncertain, and run it on episodes where pi0.5 actually fails.
